What Peakly is

Peakly helps you find a good ski or beach weekend by combining live weather forecasts with flight pricing. The score, "deal" labels, and confidence badges are estimates, not guarantees.

Forecasts and prices are estimates

  • Weather forecasts come from Open-Meteo. Conditions change. A "GO" weekend can deteriorate; a "marginal" weekend can turn out perfect. Always re-check before you book.
  • Flight prices come from Travelpayouts/Aviasales. Prices update constantly; the figure shown may not match what the airline charges at checkout. Use the booking link to see live availability.
  • Peakly does not sell flights, hotels, or any travel product. All bookings happen on third-party sites under their own terms.

No warranty

Peakly is provided "as is," without warranty of any kind. We don't guarantee the Service will be available, accurate, or fit for any particular purpose. Travel decisions and any losses (missed flights, bad conditions, money spent) are your responsibility.

Affiliate relationships

Outbound links to flight bookings (Aviasales/Travelpayouts), hotels (Booking.com), travel insurance (SafetyWing), and gear (Amazon) earn Peakly a small commission. Rankings within Peakly are based on conditions and price; affiliate status does not influence which venues surface first.
